title: Hyperion
author: Dan Simmons
summary: Seven pilgrims travel across a remote planet to a mysterious creature called the Shrike, in the shadow of a looming interstellar war. On the way each tells the story of how they came to be there.
readIf: you like layered, ambitious space opera told as separate stories, each with its own genre and mood.
skipIf: you want the whole plot resolved, since this book ends partway and needs its sequel.

pairings.reason: Another vast, serious far-future saga, with religion and politics as heavy as the technology.
Also a book of nested stories in different voices that slowly reveal a larger pattern.
A newer, emotionally intense epic that likewise mixes myth and science.
